verdict.rationale: iTerm2 exposes a programmatic control surface (Python API and AppleScript), so scoping what an agent may do through it is a fair question for this product. The evidence never shows iTerm2 issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. The only key mentioned is the user's own third-party LLM API key, which configures the AI feature rather than granting an agent limited access to iTerm2.
